name: Skrap.ai
tagline: Verify emails, find verified work emails and search B2B leads
description:
Skrap.ai's hosted MCP server. Ask in plain language and Cline can:

- verify an email address (valid, risky, invalid or unknown), one at a time or as a bulk job of up to 5,000 addresses
- find a person's verified work email from their name and company, one at a time or in bulk
- search people and companies by title, company, location and other filters, then get a lead's verified email
- look up company details, save leads to your Skrap.ai lists and check your remaining credits

Every tool states its credit cost. Invalid, unknown and not-found results use no credits. Sign in with your Skrap.ai account over OAuth on first use (a free account includes 100 one-time credits). Setup guide: https://skrap.ai/mcp

install.notes: Cline opens a browser window on first use: sign in with your Skrap.ai account to authorise access. You can revoke it any time in Skrap.ai under Settings → API keys & MCP.
